where.screen_path: People tab → New handshake → r-preview (in-person) or not-here panel (remote): chip picker. ConnectionCard: relationship chip alongside Tier P/R badge.

what.action: Per-peer chat sub-cut 2a — optional relationship leaf on handshakes
what.summary: Folded the relationship-label-on-handshake idea (brief 2026-05-24-per-peer-chat-surface-roadmap.md section 7) into the data layer and the existing HandshakeModal builder UX. Optional family/friend/coworker/acquaintance/other leaf chosen by the builder via a chip picker at both build-points (r-preview for in-person, not-here panel for remote initiator), surfaced for explicit agreement to the co-signer in the i-preview step so both signatures cover the value, and rendered as a chip on ConnectionCard alongside the Tier P/R badge in both Classic and Fresh themes (FreshCrew renders ConnectionCard below its bubble row). Leaf omitted from envelope when unset for back-compat with older handshakes. Branch rebased onto origin/main (43 commits drift from other Carpenter's Fresh roadmap arc) before cutting; prior session's comms close-out skipped during rebase and replaced with this fresh aggregate close-out.

why.text: Operator picked Option B from the three-way fork after the cross-Carpenter drift alert: rebase onto main, resolve comms by appending, fold the relationship-label fix into the Cut 2 re-design. The relationship leaf was flagged in the brief's section 7 as a sibling cut pairing naturally with the chat surface; folding it into Cut 2a means the per-peer thread UI in 2b can render the relationship chip in the thread header from its first commit rather than retrofitting later, and the recovery cohort picker gets sane defaults to lean on for free.

outcome.notes: [P-001] ✓ Rebased onto origin/main; 2 commits replayed clean, 1 prior comms commit skipped (replaced by this close-out). Branch force-with-leased. [P-002] ✓ createHandshake.ts: optional relationship param on both builders, leaf omitted when empty, readHandshake extracts it, HandshakeView gains relationship: string. [P-003] ✓ HandshakeModal.tsx: RELATIONSHIPS array + relationshipLabel + RelationshipChips component; wired into r-preview and not-here panel; i-preview reads back and surfaces 'They labelled this connection: X. Co-signing means you agree.' so co-signature is conscious. [P-004] ✓ ConnectionCard.tsx: relationship chip alongside Tier P/R badge, theme-aware. FreshCrew picks it up transitively. [P-005] ✓ 5 new tests in createHandshake.test.ts: in-person round-trip, remote round-trip, undefined-omits-leaf, empty-string-omits-leaf, both-signatures-cover-leaf. [P-006] ✓ Manifest extended. [P-007] ✓ All 4 gates green — typecheck, lint, 60/60 tests (5 new), build (4.09s). [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: cross-Carpenter drift alert at session start was load-bearing — without it I'd have built Cut 2 against stale assumptions about HomeScreen / connections / theme defaults.

confidence.uncertainty: Sub-cut 2b (per-peer thread UI) was deliberately punted to its own dispatch — it's both the largest single piece of the chat arc by code volume and has an unresolved architecture call (in-memory chat history in WalletContext vs IDB-paged from a future messagesStore). Operator should make that call before 2b starts. Also: relationship picker is chips-only — no free-text 'custom' option for relationships outside the 5 presets. If a user wants 'spouse' or 'sibling' or 'mentor', they pick Other today; future cut can add free-text if the audience pilot signals it matters.
